warning: Combined file is descriptive only. Do not pool cohorts for fitting without a design addressing cohort-target confounding.
pooled_training_note: TCGA-LUAD contains only LUAD and TCGA-LUSC only LUSC, so cohort membership is confounded with the target in the TCGA export.
imputation_policy: None applied. Missing values are retained; any imputation must be fitted on training data only.

sex_at_baseline.normalization_rule: Female/Male (case-insensitive) -> female/male; every other value -> missing.
sex_at_baseline.cohort_definition_differences: MSK 'Sex' and TCGA 'gender' are both recorded sex; no known definition difference.

age_at_diagnosis.normalization_rule: Plain numeric in [0, 120]; markers, metadata and non-numeric text -> missing.
age_at_diagnosis.leakage_timing_concerns: Low for TCGA. MSK 'Current Age' is age at the data snapshot, not at diagnosis, and is capped at 89 in the source.
age_at_diagnosis.cohort_definition_differences: NOT equivalent: MSK is current age (>= age at diagnosis); TCGA is age at initial diagnosis.

smoking_history.normalization_rule: MSK: Never -> never; Former/Current Smoker -> former_or_current; Unknown -> missing. TCGA codes 1-5 -> missing until verified against the data dictionary.
smoking_history.leakage_timing_concerns: Moderate for MSK: NLP-derived from clinical notes of unspecified timing.
smoking_history.cohort_definition_differences: TCGA is unpopulated by design; no more specific status is inferred.

smoking_pack_years.normalization_rule: Plain numeric in [0, 300]; markers, metadata and non-numeric text -> missing.
smoking_pack_years.cohort_definition_differences: Not available in the MSK patient table.

ecog_score.normalization_rule: Integer in [0, 4]; markers, metadata and non-numeric text -> missing.
ecog_score.leakage_timing_concerns: Timing relative to treatment is not documented in the TCGA table.
ecog_score.cohort_definition_differences: Not available in the MSK patient table (performance status is a separate timeline).

stage.normalization_rule: MSK: 'Stage 1-3' -> stage_1_3, 'Stage 4' -> stage_4. TCGA: 'Stage IA'.. -> stage_ia etc. Anything else -> missing. TCGA clinical stage is not used (mostly [Not Applicable]).
stage.cohort_definition_differences: NOT equivalent: MSK is highest recorded stage binned to 1-3/4; TCGA is AJCC pathologic stage. Category sets are disjoint, so the column is not comparable across cohorts.

prior_treatment_msk_prior_medication.normalization_rule: 'Prior medications to MSK' -> yes; 'No prior medications' -> no; Unknown -> missing.
prior_treatment_msk_prior_medication.leakage_timing_concerns: NLP-derived from initial consult notes; timing relative to diagnosis is limited.
prior_treatment_msk_prior_medication.cohort_definition_differences: Anti-cancer medication received before MSK care; not equivalent to TCGA neoadjuvant treatment.

prior_treatment_tcga_neoadjuvant.normalization_rule: Yes (including 'Yes, ...' variants) -> yes; No -> no; markers -> missing.
prior_treatment_tcga_neoadjuvant.cohort_definition_differences: Neoadjuvant treatment before surgery; not equivalent to MSK prior medications.
